categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of rare earth permanent magnet material application devices. Its main products include single magnet application devices and magnetic component application devices, which are used in consumer electronics such as laptops, tablets, smartphones, smart home products, electronic accessories, and motor products. The company also focuses on expanding into automotive, motor, and robotics applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes high magnetic energy product technology with precise molding processes to produce stable and high-performance magnets. It has developed core technologies in magnetic circuit design, precision processing, surface treatment, magnetization, and intelligent assembly. The company also invests in automation and smart factory 4.0 platform construction to enhance production efficiency and quality control. Key R&D projects include NdFeB magnetic powder recycling, laser cutting of thin magnets, multi-layer nickel plating, and new magnetic material development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are international well-known consumer electronics brands and their OEMs, including Foxconn, BYD, and Lika Precision. The company serves end markets such as consumer electronics (smartphones, laptops, tablets, TWS earphones, smartwatches), new energy vehicles, energy-saving appliances, wind power, robotics, and industrial automation. The company maintains close cooperation with these customers and has received multiple supplier awards.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Baotou, Inner Mongolia, a major rare earth resource base. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Kunshan, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, and Vietnam, enabling it to serve both domestic and international markets. Export sales account for over 57% of revenue, indicating significant overseas market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the rare earth permanent magnet supply chain, focusing on deep processing of sintered NdFeB magnetic blanks into finished magnetic devices and components. It sources raw materials such as praseodymium and neodymium metals primarily from upstream suppliers like Northern Rare Earth Group and integrates downstream with consumer electronics and automotive manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include increasing R&D investment to drive technological innovation, expanding product lines, and enhancing product added value. The company emphasizes green and sustainable development, aiming to improve energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. R&D focuses on recycling magnetic powder, advanced assembly processes, laser cutting, multi-layer plating, and new magnetic materials for emerging applications like medical devices and robotics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized rare earth permanent magnet application devices and magnetic components. The company uses a 'make-to-order plus demand forecasting' production model and maintains close collaboration with customers for product design, development, and delivery. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales agreements with major customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The domestic rare earth permanent magnet industry is fragmented with many small players and product homogeneity. The company is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise with strong R&D capabilities and a diversified product portfolio, holding a core supplier status for major international consumer electronics brands. It has competitive advantages in technology, quality, and supply chain stability, supported by awards from key customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.18 billion, a 24.45% increase from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 177 million, up 28.15%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with a net asset return rate of 21.47%. Cash and cash equivalents increased significantly due to capital raised from its initial public offering in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, high-performance, and cost-effective rare earth permanent magnet devices tailored to customer specifications. Its value proposition includes advanced magnetic circuit design to optimize material usage, mature precision manufacturing processes, and intelligent assembly to improve product consistency and reduce costs. The company leverages its geographic advantage in Inner Mongolia for stable raw material supply and focuses on green manufacturing and sustainable development to meet evolving market demands.
